definitions.explanation: Physical strength or power. Also used for ability, capability, or influence.

examples.japanese: {全力|ぜんりょく}を{尽|つ}くします。
examples.english: I will do my best. (lit. exhaust all my power)

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}の{力|ちから}を{伸|の}ばしたい。
examples.english: I want to improve my Japanese ability.

notes:
{力|ちから} has many uses from physical strength to abstract power or ability.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {体力|たいりょく}: physical strength
- {能力|のうりょく}: ability, capability
- {努力|どりょく}: effort
- {協力|きょうりょく}: cooperation
- {全力|ぜんりょく}: full power, best effort
- {電力|でんりょく}: electric power

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {力|ちから}になる: to be of help
- {力|ちから}を{入|い}れる: to put effort into
- {力|ちから}を{貸|か}す: to lend a hand
- {力|ちから}{不足|ぶそく}: lack of ability
